levels.surface: أبو يزيد محمد بن يحيى بن خلف بن يزيد المروزي

notes: The epithets «المعروف بأبي علي بن عبد ربه» and «المعروف بإسحاق بن راهويه» are left out of the surfaces: the text gives the same man once under his nasab; epithet trimming is deferred
«بَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» gives a place, but Ibn Masud answers and his words are the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6)
The youth who asks is in the scene; the compiler's later commentary is not a route
